Package com.helix.profiler.flamegraph

Class FlameGraphAggregator

java.lang.Object
com.helix.profiler.flamegraph.FlameGraphAggregator
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProfileEventListener, AutoCloseable
public class FlameGraphAggregator extends Object implements ProfileEventListener, AutoCloseable
In-memory folded stack trace aggregation engine that transforms execution and allocation samples from internal profilers, thread dumps, and JDK Flight Recorder (JFR) into hierarchical flame graph call trees.

Supports dynamic switching between CPU execution samples (MetricType.CPU_TIME) and Heap memory allocation bytes (MetricType.ALLOCATION_BYTES). Outputs folded stack data strictly matching Brendan Gregg's FlameGraph specification.

    • ingestJfr

      public void ingestJfr(Path jfrFile) throws IOException
      Ingests events from a JDK Flight Recorder (.jfr) recording file. Automatically extracts CPU samples (jdk.ExecutionSample) into MetricType.CPU_TIME and heap allocations (jdk.ObjectAllocation*) into MetricType.ALLOCATION_BYTES.
      Parameters:
      jfrFile - path to .jfr file
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading the file fails
